## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a large and heavy young man with a round, expressionless face. His countenance is also described as broad and freckled.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a large, stout, and stolid youth who possesses a round, expressionless face. He exhibits a painful lack of conversational ability and is notably shy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)_

## History

Billy Andrews's father eventually gave him the upper farm in his own name, clearing the way for him to marry. Prior to this, Billy drove [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) in his carriage. He later sent [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to propose marriage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), +4 more_
